title: Government Service Delivery Improvement Act
official_summary:
Government Service Delivery Improvement Act

This bill requires that certain government officials be responsible for improving government service delivery (i.e., providing benefits or services to individuals, businesses, and organizations via agencies or programs).

The bill requires the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) to designate or appoint a senior official within OMB as the Federal Government Service Delivery Lead. The primary responsibility of this individual shall be to coordinate government-wide efforts to improve government service delivery. The bill also requires the heads of certain executive branch agencies to be responsible for their respective agency's government service delivery, including continuously improving and enhancing government services. Each such agency head shall also designate or appoint a senior official of the agency whose duties shall include coordinating and executing efforts to improve and enhance the agency's government service delivery.

summary.headline: New law requires the White House budget office and federal agencies to name officials in charge of improving how government services are delivered.
summary.what_it_does: The White House Office of Management and Budget (OMB) must name a senior official as the Federal Government Service Delivery Lead. This person coordinates efforts across the whole government to improve how benefits and services reach people, businesses, and organizations. Heads of certain federal agencies are made responsible for their agency's service delivery and must name a senior official to lead improvement efforts.

who_it_affects.how: Must designate or appoint a senior official to coordinate government-wide service delivery improvements.

who_it_affects.group: Heads of certain federal executive agencies
who_it_affects.how: Become responsible for continuously improving their agency's services and must name a senior official to lead that work.

who_it_affects.group: Individuals, businesses, and organizations that get federal benefits or services
who_it_affects.how: Are the intended focus of the improvement efforts, though the summary does not describe specific changes to any benefit or service.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025; the summary does not list a separate start date or deadlines.
